baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive result form مُّؤْصَدَةٌ is predicated with عَلَيْهِم, placing the completed closure over or against the occupants.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both mapped roots converge on shutting a door firmly. The construction therefore presents an externally completed seal with a directional asymmetry: something can be closed upon the occupants, while they have no corresponding route outward.

activation_trace.role: Closing over and shutting in supplies the literal completed seal and makes it a containment imposed upon those inside.
The firmly sealed door sharpens the closure from a loose covering into a secured, exit-denying barrier.

changed_reading.after: A completed seal is fastened over them from the controlling side of the boundary, making non-exit the ayah's primary spatial force.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُّؤْصَدَةٌ can activate not only the shut door but the containing enclosure associated with the same focus root.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pen and stone chamber images change the geometry from one blocked aperture to a whole containing environment. عَلَيْهِم then reads as the enclosure closing over its contents, not merely a door somewhere beside them.

activation_trace.role: The enclosing pen contributes containment on several sides and recasts the sealed object as an environment holding what is within.
The stone pen in a mountain gives the enclosure mass, depth, and a chamber-like relation to its confined contents.

changed_reading.after: The entire place functions as a containing pen or chamber whose closure comes down over those held within it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root also supplies adjoining forecourt, threshold, and doorway images, while عَلَيْهِم marks the people as the side upon which the boundary closes.
baseline_models.mechanism: These branches locate the decisive action at an interface joined to a dwelling or chamber. The ayah can therefore be heard as capture at the last threshold: the boundary that might have mediated passage instead becomes the mechanism that fixes inside and outside.

activation_trace.role: The courtyard or threshold-close supplies a liminal zone and makes failed passage, rather than mere walling, central to the closure.
The doorway or forecourt joined to a dwelling turns the boundary into an attached interface that can decisively assign the occupants to the inside.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a static sealed location.
changed_reading.after: The verse freezes a threshold at the moment it ceases to permit passage and becomes the captor of those on its inner side.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening social acts carry images of surrounding, pressing, and pushing. When the focus seal later closes عَلَيْهِم, those outward acts acquire a material recoil: agents who compressed and displaced others are themselves placed under an all-around, exit-denying pressure.

activation_trace.role: Closing over and shutting in supplies the terminal enclosure into which the earlier pressure can be reversed.
The encircling crown contributes an all-around topology, turning totality into circumferential pressure around the agents.
Hand-pressure and squeezing materialize the aggressor's social action as compression that the later seal can return upon him.
Pushing supplies the outward displacement that is reversed when the plural objects are shut in rather than able to push others aside.

structural_cues: The opening agent nouns precede the later plural pronoun عَلَيْهِم, allowing the same people to move from sources of pressure to recipients of closure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encirclement, squeezing, pushing, and a seal; I supply the retaliatory arrow from their outward pressure to pressure returned upon them. A live alternative is that the social acts merely identify the occupants and the closure has no mimetic relation to those acts.

changed_reading.before: The seal is a generic punishment imposed on the named offenders.
changed_reading.after: The seal is a spatial reversal of their own practice: those who pressed and pushed people are now compressed inside an all-around boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering draws dispersed units into one grasp, wealth supplies the accumulated contents, and repeated counting keeps re-closing the collection as a controlled total. The focus enclosure reverses possession: the collector's clasped aggregate becomes the form of a clasp around its collector.

activation_trace.role: The pen containing what lies inside supplies the focus geometry into which the collector's gathered total is reversed.
The fist closing its fingers provides a concrete clasp for gathering and lets accumulation prefigure the later fastening.
The taking and multiplying of wealth supplies the contents whose controlled abundance defines the collector's prior agency.
Counting that returns with time contributes iterative rechecking, making the hoard a repeatedly secured total rather than a single acquisition.

structural_cues: The chained verbs جَمَعَ and عَدَّدَهُ give the offender active control over bounded contents; عَلَيْهِم later makes him the bounded content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a closing fist, accumulated wealth, recurrent counting, and an enclosure; I infer an agency reversal in which the practiced clasp becomes a clasp around the practitioner. The live alternative is a simple moral sequence with no material echo between hoarding and sealing.

changed_reading.before: The hoarder is later placed in an unrelated closed punishment.
changed_reading.after: His own logic of gathering, grasping, and repeatedly securing a total returns as an enclosure that gathers and secures him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imagined causal chain runs from wealth to enduring life. The completed seal does not simply cancel that wish; it grotesquely changes its terms, replacing free persistence through possession with persistence in a condition from which departure is barred.

activation_trace.role: The securely fastened door converts permanence into enforced non-departure rather than protected life.
Supposition marks the wealth-to-permanence link as the offender's constructed causal model, available for reversal.
Abundant owned wealth supplies the imagined instrument by which the offender expects to secure duration.
Stable continuance resistant to passing away supplies the desired duration that the seal recodes as confinement.
Clinging and remaining attached make the revised permanence spatial: the occupant is fixed to the enclosed state.

structural_cues: The clause أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ explicitly gives wealth a supposed causative role, while the passive focus form removes the offender's control over the resulting duration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, wealth, resistant continuance, clinging, and a secured door; I infer ironic fulfillment, with desired permanence reversed into imposed non-exit. A live alternative is that closure only follows the failed belief and does not answer it in the same semantic currency.

changed_reading.before: The seal merely disproves the belief that wealth grants immortality.
changed_reading.after: The seal counterfeits the desired immortality: he receives lastingness as forced attachment to a state he cannot leave.

context_deltas.mechanism: Casting supplies entry velocity and crushing supplies destructive impact, but neither alone explains why the process cannot be escaped. The focus closure becomes the terminal capture phase: what is thrown into the crusher is held inside the operation after impact.

changed_reading.before: The closure is one solid door laid across one opening.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the seal is a dense interlocked mesh: many gathered and extended elements close every route through their connected structure.

strongest_changes: The context changes a static shut door into a sealed furnace: the kindled fire itself can close over them, joining burning and non-exit in one mechanism.
Gathering, grasping, recurrent counting, and imagined permanence reverse upon the offender, so his techniques for securing wealth become techniques for securing him.
The paired عَلَى relations make the boundary directionally asymmetric: fire and exposure reach the inner heart while the enclosed person has no reciprocal route outward.
The following extended supports turn closure into a braced, spatially extended, and potentially durational lock.
summary.what_was_special: The split focus mapping did more than duplicate the ordinary sealed-door sense: it preserved pen, threshold, stone chamber, close-rooted mesh, and close-worn-layer geometries. The split د ر ي mapping likewise allowed knowledge and vortex images to coexist, producing an exploratory epistemic reading without displacing the stronger furnace and engineered-lock models.
remaining_uncertainties: إِنَّهَا most readily resumes the preceding feminine fire or its named crusher, but those antecedent scopes alter whether fire itself is the enclosure or burns inside it.
The extended columns may be closure hardware, surrounding architecture, instruments within the punishment, or several of these at once.
The temporal force drawn from permanence and extension is coherent but remains inferential beside the stronger spatial non-exit.
The garment, processing-vessel, vortex, and interlocked-mesh readings should remain explicit material analogies rather than unqualified lexical renderings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sealed permanence replacing imagined permanence.** Evidence: `و ص د B001` (door sealed shut), activated by `خ ل د B001/B002` in 104:3 and `م د د B004` in 104:9. Structural cue: the pronoun points back to the fire/Hutamah after the false immortalizing claim. Assigned role: إيصاد supplies closure and irreversibility. Abductive move: the imagined permanence of wealth is answered by a real permanence of confinement. Reading change: the ayah reads as the conversion of false security into sealed exposure.

2. **The wealth-keeper becomes penned property.** Evidence: `و ص د B003` (stone pen for livestock/property in the mountain), activated by `م و ل B001` and `ج م ع B001` in 104:2. Structural cue: the enclosure falls "upon them" after wealth/property has dominated the human subject. Assigned role: وصيدة provides a property-pen image. Abductive move: one who organized life around مال is placed inside a structure analogous to where مال is kept. Reading change: the human possessor is reread as possessed/penned.

3. **Anti-house and anti-shelter.** Evidence: `و ص د B002` (forecourt/doorway joined to dwelling) and `ك ل ل B006` (curtain or sewn shelter), activated by `ر ح م B003` in 104:0. Structural cue: enclosure vocabulary at the end answers the opening mercy/womb frame. Assigned role: موصدة supplies dwelling-like closure without hospitality. Abductive move: a shelter can protect or trap depending on the moral relation it encloses. Reading change: the fire is an inverted dwelling: a house with no mercy, door with no exit, covering with no protection.

4. **Close-rooted confinement.** Evidence: `و ص د B004` (plants with roots growing close together), activated by `ج م ع B001` and `م د د B003` only exploratorily. Structural cue: gathered roots/plants faintly echo gathered wealth and extended water/support images. Assigned role: this branch supplies a compact interlacing image. Abductive move: enclosure may be felt not only as a door but as tight growth with no spacing. Reading change: the ayah can carry an added sense of packed closeness, though this remains weaker than the door/pen readings.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 104:9 resolved the mechanism of closure: the seal is not abstract but held in/with extended supports. Looking back, 104:8 also made 104:3's أخلده ironic—the lasting state he sought arrives as being shut over, not life preserved.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Closure after penetration creates a one-way trap.** Fixed `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` realizes `و ص د B001`, a door fastened or sealed shut. The immediately prior fire reaches the hearts through `ط ل ع B006` (an access-route) and `ف ء د B003` (a struck heart), while the pronoun and `عَلَيْهِم` place the closure over the occupants. The packet supplies inward access followed by sealing; I infer that entry remains possible precisely where exit is denied. The ayah therefore reads as the valve-stage of the mechanism, not as a static description of a closed place.

2. **A promised dwelling reversed into compulsory dwelling.** Fixed `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` activates `و ص د B002`, the forecourt or doorway joined to a dwelling. Within the focus window, `104:3` supplies wealth (`م و ل B001`) and clinging or settling (`خ ل د B002`), while `104:4` supplies involuntary casting. The packet gives a permanence-claim, displacement, and an attached doorway; I infer a reversal from property-backed residence to residence without freedom of threshold. The closure reads as a grim house-relation: the person who expected wealth to stabilize a dwelling is made to remain where the doorway no longer functions as passage.

3. **The property-holder becomes enclosed property.** Fixed `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` also activates `و ص د B003`, a stone pen made for livestock or property. `ٱلْحُطَمَةُ` activates `ح ط م B004`, the harsh driver who crowds livestock, while the earlier fixed `مَالَهُ`, `م و ل B001`, supplies the subject's property-system. The packet supplies pen, driver, property, and people enclosed under `عَلَيْهِم`; I infer the role reversal by which the owner is handled as guarded stock. The ayah can therefore read as dispossession more radical than loss of wealth: the former possessor becomes the contained possession.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `104:9` supplied the missing mechanics of `و ص د B001`: extended columns can brace what `مُّؤْصَدَةٌ` closes. This later detail changed closure from a momentary shut door into maintained infrastructure. It also sharpened the `و ص د B003` property-pen activation, because the former owner is not merely inside a boundary but held there by a reinforced containment system.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الوصيدة: حجرة أو شبه حظيرة من حجارة تتخذ للمال في الجبل، ومنه استوصد في الجبل إذا اتخذها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الحظيرة من الغصنة عند الصحاح، ولا مطلق الفناء أو إغلاق الباب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الوصيدة كالحظيرة تتخذ للمال إلا أنها من الحجارة والحظيرة من الغصنة واستوصدت في الجبل (sihah)؛ الوصيدة حجرة تجعل للمال في الجبل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bitkiyi köklerinin birbirine yakın olmasıyla tanımlar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu ölçütü doğru biçimde korur ve onu genel bitki sıklığı ya da dal dolaşıklığıyla karıştırmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yakınlık bitkinin üst bölümünde değil kökler arasındadır; yalnızca sık ya da bol bitki yeterli değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca kökleri birbirine yakın bitkiyi adlandıran belirtilmiş sözcükle sınırlıdır ve genel bir kök anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kökleri birbirine yakın duran, dipten sık ve bitişik görünüm veren bitki ya da bitki topluluğudur.

facets.statement: Ayırt edici özellik, bitki köklerinin birbirine yakın aralıklarla bulunmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bitkiyi ortak biçimde köklerinin birbirine yakın oluşuyla tanımlar; belirleyici ölçüt bitkinin türü, boyu ya da dal sayısı değil kökler arasındaki yakınlıktır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bitkiyi kökler arasındaki yakınlık ölçütüyle tanımlar ve başka bir sıklık türü eklemez.

error_profile.preserves: Bitki göndergesini ve köklerin birbirine yakın oluşunu eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kök yakınlığının yüzeyde dipten sık bir görünüm oluşturduğu betimleyici bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkilerin dip bölümündeki sık ve yakın düzeni korur.
error_profile.adds: Kök yakınlığı dışında genel bir örtü yoğunluğu izlenimi ekleyebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıklık özellikle köklerin birbirine yakın aralıklarla bulunmasına dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yerde çok sayıda bitki ya da ağaç bulunmasına ve genel yoğun görünüme dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bitkilerin sık ve yoğun görünmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal miktar ve genel yoğunluğu öne çıkarır; bu dalda belirleyici olan bitki sayısı değil köklerin birbirine yakınlığıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yakınlık bitkinin toprak altındaki ya da dipteki kök düzenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yoğunluk dalların çokluğu ve birbirine dolanıp sıkı biçimde örtüşmesindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: dalları çok ve birbirine geçmiş ağaç
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bitkinin parçalarının birbirine yakın ve sık bir düzen oluşturmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal köklerin yakınlığını ölçüt alır; komşu dal ise dalların çoğalması ve birbirine geçmesiyle oluşan üst bölüm yoğunluğunu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bitki kökleri aynı düzlemde birbirine yakın konumlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Doğal cisimler, bulutlar ya da ürünler üst üste dizilip katman oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğal varlıkların aralarında az boşluk kalacak biçimde düzenlenmesini anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal köklerin yan yana yakınlığıdır; komşu dalın belirleyici ilişkisi cisimlerin üst üste binmesi ve katmanlaşmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Genel bitki yoğunluğu, dal dolaşıklığı ve üst üste dizilme en açıklayıcı karşıtlardır; belirli bitki türleri, kumda büyüme, diken filizi ve belirli ağaçlık alan adayları yalnızca bitki alanını paylaşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الوصيد بمعنى النبت أو النبات المتقارب الأصول.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الفناء أو الباب أو الوصيدة الحجرية أو إطباق الباب إلا من جهة أصل التقارب والضم.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الوصيد النبت المتقارب الأصول (maqayis)؛ الوصيد النبات المتقارب الاصول (sihah)؛ الوصيد المتقارب الأصول (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları, şeyleri birbirine yaklaştırıp bitiştirme düşüncesi çevresinde kapının sıkıca kapanması, eve bağlı açık alan veya kapı, dağdaki taş hayvan barınağı ve kökleri yakın bitkiler olarak ayrılaşır.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
